test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The clock that we have in our town square is __a big __in the whole town
solution:
The correct answer is **"the biggest"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Here in this statement one is comparing the clock in the town square with respect to all the watches in town.
 
• Superlative degrees are used for such types of comparisons and **"the biggest"** is the superlative degree.
 
• Also we do not use the article **"a"** with superlative degrees because superlatives make the noun specific and the article **"the" **is used with specific nouns.
 
 
• Example: *This glass is **the biggest** of all the four glasses in the shop.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct option here is **the biggest**(option 3).

 

**The correct sentence is**: *The clock that we have in our town square is **the biggest **in the whole town.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us have a look at the other options also:

 
• **"The bigger"** is a comparative degree and these degrees are used to compare two things only.

 
 
• Example:* This watch is **bigger** than the other one.*
 
 
 
• **"The big"** is simply used when we are talking about only one specific thing.
 
 
• Example:* **The big** house.*
 
 
 
• **"A biggest"** is never used because we do not use the article "a" with superlative degrees.
